message: the macro's own `helper` is shadowed at this invocation
notes: a template's free identifier means what it meant where the macro was WRITTEN (macro-system.md MAC-HYG-6). An entry-file macro has nothing to qualify to, so this reference would silently become the local one - MAC-HYG-8's first hole, which scope sets (MAC-HYG-9) close and this refusal makes visible in the meantime
help: rename the binding at the call site, or move the macro into a module, where its free identifiers resolve to that module and nothing here can shadow them (`helper` would become `Mod$` + the name)
